newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai stocks seen firming, likely profit taking.
newsitem.headline: Thai stocks seen firming, likely profit taking.

text.p: Thai stocks are expected to gain further on more carryover buying by foreign investors, but some profit taking could stem any sharp rises, brokers said.
"Foreign investors remain in the buying mood right now. But there would be some profit taking as some shares are already quite high," said one broker at Chao Phaya Finance.
Thai stocks on Friday ended 8.16 points or 1.57 percent higher to 528.18 on 5.79 billion baht turnover.
A Bank of Thailand announcement on Monday that there would be no more new troubled finance firms would also ease investor worries, brokers said.
